metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel scheduled analytics rules for the Nutanix_CL custom table. Covers both security/audit detections and operational/availability alerts. Alert-severity-based rules fire only on 'critical' and 'warning'. Deploy after table.json + the collector are live.
Name of the Sentinel-enabled Log Analytics workspace.
Set false to deploy the rules disabled (review before they create incidents).

properties.displayName: Nutanix - Critical or Warning alert raised
properties.description: A Nutanix Prism alert with severity critical or warning was ingested. Surfaces cluster-level problems for triage.
properties.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "alert"
| where tolower(Severity) in ("critical", "warning")
| extend AccountCustomEntity = ActorUser, HostCustomEntity = NutanixClusterName

properties.displayName: Nutanix - Repeated failed audit operations by a user
properties.description: Five or more failed Nutanix audit operations by the same user within the lookback window. May indicate credential misuse, brute force, or automation with bad credentials.
properties.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "audit"
| where tolower(Severity) == "failed"
| summarize FailedCount = count(), Operations = make_set(OperationType, 10), Messages = make_set(Message, 5), StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated) by ActorUser, NutanixClusterName
| where FailedCount >= 5
| extend AccountCustomEntity = ActorUser, HostCustomEntity = NutanixClusterName

properties.displayName: Nutanix - Identity or security configuration change
properties.description: Create/update/delete audit operation targeting identity or security objects (users, roles, directories, certificates, auth/policy). Tracks privilege and security-posture changes.
properties.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "audit"
| where OperationType in~ ("CREATE", "UPDATE", "DELETE")
| where tolower(SourceEntityType) has_any ("user", "role", "directory", "cert", "auth", "identity", "idp", "saml", "ldap", "policy")
    or Message has_any ("role", "permission", "password", "certificate", "directory service", "authentication", "LDAP", "SAML")
| extend AccountCustomEntity = ActorUser, HostCustomEntity = NutanixClusterName

properties.displayName: Nutanix - Destructive VM/host/cluster operation
properties.description: Delete or destructive audit operation (delete, power-off, destroy, migrate, evacuate, reset) against a VM, host, cluster, or storage object. Potential impact / sabotage.
properties.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "audit"
| where tolower(SourceEntityType) has_any ("vm", "host", "cluster", "storage_container", "volume_group")
| where OperationType in~ ("DELETE")
    or Message has_any ("delete", "power off", "power_off", "destroy", "remove", "migrate", "evacuate", "shutdown", "reset")
| extend AccountCustomEntity = ActorUser, HostCustomEntity = NutanixClusterName

properties.displayName: Nutanix - Availability or hardware alert (critical/warning)
properties.description: Critical or warning Nutanix alert relating to availability, storage, data protection, capacity, hardware, or network. Operational health signal.
properties.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "alert"
| where tolower(Severity) in ("critical", "warning")
| where tostring(RawPayload.classifications) has_any ("availability", "storage", "data protection", "capacity", "hardware", "network")
    or Message has_any ("unreachable", "down", "degraded", "offline", "disconnected", "space", "failed disk", "fan", "temperature", "power supply")
| extend HostCustomEntity = NutanixClusterName

properties.displayName: Nutanix - Collector ingestion gap (health)
properties.description: No Nutanix_CL records ingested in over 2 hours (or none at all in the last 2 days). Indicates the collector, scheduled task, credentials, or network path to Prism has failed.
properties.query:
// queryPeriod is 2 days so a dead collector still returns a (null) LastSeen row that we can alert on.
Nutanix_CL
| summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
| extend GapMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', now(), coalesce(LastSeen, ago(2d)))
| where GapMinutes > 120

properties.displayName: Nutanix - Failed logins followed by a successful login (possible brute force)
properties.description: The same user had 5+ failed Prism logins and at least one success in the window, with the success after the first failure. Stronger signal than failures alone: a likely successful password-guess / credential-stuffing attempt. Login IP(s) are surfaced from the audit records.
properties.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "audit"
| where OperationType == "LOGIN"
| extend Outcome = case(Message contains "failed to log in" or tolower(Severity) == "failed", "fail", Message contains "has logged in" or tolower(Severity) == "succeeded", "success", "other")
| where Outcome in ("fail", "success")
| summarize Fails = countif(Outcome == "fail"), Succeeds = countif(Outcome == "success"), FirstFail = minif(TimeGenerated, Outcome == "fail"), LastSuccess = maxif(TimeGenerated, Outcome == "success"), SourceIps = make_set(SourceIp, 10) by ActorUser, NutanixClusterName
| where Fails >= 5 and Succeeds >= 1 and LastSuccess > FirstFail
| extend AccountCustomEntity = ActorUser, HostCustomEntity = NutanixClusterName

properties.displayName: Nutanix - Deletion of snapshots / backups / recovery points (anti-recovery)
properties.description: A delete/destroy operation targeting a snapshot, protection domain/policy, recovery point, recovery plan, or backup/replication target. Destroying the ability to restore is a classic ransomware precursor (MITRE T1490 Inhibit System Recovery). Review the actor and source IP immediately.
properties.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "audit"
| where OperationType in~ ("DELETE") or Message contains "delet" or Message contains "destroy" or Message contains "remov" or Message contains "expired"
| where tolower(SourceEntityType) has_any ("snapshot", "protection", "recovery", "backup", "replication", "vm_recovery_point")
    or Message contains "snapshot" or Message contains "protection domain" or Message contains "protection policy" or Message contains "recovery point" or Message contains "recovery plan" or Message contains "backup" or Message contains "replication"
| extend AccountCustomEntity = ActorUser, HostCustomEntity = NutanixClusterName, IpCustomEntity = SourceIp

properties.displayName: Nutanix - Logging, syslog, or security control disabled (defense evasion)
properties.description: An update/delete that appears to disable audit logging, syslog/log forwarding, encryption, alerting, or authentication. Turning off telemetry or protections is a deliberate anti-forensic move (MITRE T1562 Impair Defenses) and should be alerted on immediately.
properties.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "audit"
| where OperationType in~ ("UPDATE", "DELETE", "CREATE")
| where Message contains "syslog" or Message contains "rsyslog" or Message contains "log forwarding" or Message contains "audit log"
    or ((Message contains "disable" or Message contains "turned off" or Message contains "removed") and (Message contains "syslog" or Message contains "audit" or Message contains "logging" or Message contains "encryption" or Message contains "alerting" or Message contains "authentication" or Message contains "password complexity" or Message contains "session timeout"))
| extend AccountCustomEntity = ActorUser, HostCustomEntity = NutanixClusterName, IpCustomEntity = SourceIp

properties.displayName: Nutanix - SSH key added or cluster lockdown disabled (backdoor persistence)
properties.description: An SSH public key was added, cluster lockdown mode was disabled, or SSH access was enabled on a CVM/host. These create durable, direct backdoor access to the cluster (MITRE T1098 Account Manipulation / Persistence). Verify the change was authorized.
properties.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "audit"
| where Message contains "public key" or Message contains "ssh key" or Message contains "authorized_keys" or Message contains "cluster lockdown" or Message contains "lockdown mode"
    or (Message contains "ssh" and (Message contains "enable" or Message contains "added" or Message contains "key" or Message contains "access"))
| extend AccountCustomEntity = ActorUser, HostCustomEntity = NutanixClusterName, IpCustomEntity = SourceIp

properties.displayName: Nutanix - New user, API key, or service account created (persistence)
properties.description: A new local user, API key (User Key), or service account was created. New credentials are a common persistence mechanism (MITRE T1136 Create Account). Legitimate onboarding also triggers this - confirm the new principal is expected.
properties.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "audit"
| where OperationType == "CREATE"
| where tolower(SourceEntityType) in ("user", "user key", "service account")
    or Message contains "created user " or Message contains "created user key" or Message contains "created service account" or Message contains "created a new user" or Message contains "api key"
| extend AccountCustomEntity = ActorUser, HostCustomEntity = NutanixClusterName, IpCustomEntity = SourceIp

properties.displayName: Nutanix - Password reset for a different user (possible account takeover)
properties.description: A user reset the password of a DIFFERENT account. While admins legitimately reset passwords, an attacker resetting another user's credential is a common takeover / lateral-movement step (MITRE T1098). The target user is extracted from the message.
properties.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "audit"
| where tolower(SourceEntityType) == "password" or Message contains "reset password"
| where OperationType in~ ("UPDATE", "CREATE")
| extend TargetUser = extract(@"reset password for user (\S+)", 1, Message)
| where isempty(TargetUser) or tolower(TargetUser) != tolower(ActorUser)
| extend AccountCustomEntity = ActorUser, HostCustomEntity = NutanixClusterName, IpCustomEntity = SourceIp

properties.displayName: Nutanix - New replication / remote site / export path created (possible exfiltration)
properties.description: Creation or change of a remote site, recovery plan, replication target, availability zone, cloud-connect endpoint, or storage-container NFS/whitelist. Attackers stand up a new replication or export path to siphon data off the cluster (MITRE T1537 Transfer Data to Cloud Account).
properties.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "audit"
| where OperationType in~ ("CREATE", "UPDATE")
| where Message contains "remote site" or Message contains "recovery plan" or Message contains "replication target" or Message contains "availability zone" or Message contains "cloud connect" or Message contains "nfs whitelist" or Message contains "filesystem whitelist" or Message contains "external repository"
    or tolower(SourceEntityType) has_any ("remote", "replication", "availability_zone", "recovery_plan")
| extend AccountCustomEntity = ActorUser, HostCustomEntity = NutanixClusterName, IpCustomEntity = SourceIp

properties.displayName: Nutanix - High volume of management operations by a single actor (velocity)
properties.description: One actor performed 30+ create/update/delete operations (excluding routine auth-token/session churn) within the hour. Wiper, ransomware, and rogue-admin activity often looks like a burst of operations rather than a single event (MITRE T1485/T1489). Tune the threshold to your environment's normal admin cadence.
properties.query:
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "audit"
| where tolower(SourceEntityType) !in ("token", "session")
| where OperationType in~ ("CREATE", "UPDATE", "DELETE")
| summarize OpCount = count(), Operations = make_set(OperationType, 5), EntityTypes = make_set(SourceEntityType, 15), SourceIps = make_set(SourceIp, 10), StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated) by ActorUser, NutanixClusterName
| where OpCount >= 30
| extend AccountCustomEntity = ActorUser, HostCustomEntity = NutanixClusterName

properties.displayName: Nutanix - Admin changes with no recorded login (possible auth bypass, CVE-2026-84731)
properties.description: An account made CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE changes in the last hour but has no successful Prism login recorded in the previous day. NXSA-0058 / CVE-2026-84731 (CVSS 9.8, public PoC) allows unauthenticated Prism access, which can surface as changes from an account that never logged in. Add API-key or automation accounts to ExcludedActors to tune.
properties.query:
// Accounts permitted to make changes without an interactive login (API-key automation, CI/CD, etc.).
let ExcludedActors = dynamic([]);
let RecentLogins = Nutanix_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where Category == "audit" and OperationType == "LOGIN"
| where Message contains "has logged in" or tolower(Severity) == "succeeded"
| distinct Actor = tolower(ActorUser);
Nutanix_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where Category == "audit"
| where tolower(SourceEntityType) !in ("token", "session")
| where OperationType in~ ("CREATE", "UPDATE", "DELETE")
| where isnotempty(ActorUser)
| extend Actor = tolower(ActorUser)
| where Actor !in (ExcludedActors)
| join kind=leftanti RecentLogins on Actor
| summarize OpCount = count(), Operations = make_set(OperationType, 5), EntityTypes = make_set(SourceEntityType, 15), Messages = make_set(Message, 10), SourceIps = make_set(SourceIp, 10), StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated) by ActorUser, NutanixClusterName
| extend AccountCustomEntity = ActorUser, HostCustomEntity = NutanixClusterName, IpCustomEntity = tostring(SourceIps[0])

properties.displayName: Nutanix - Vulnerable or unsupported AOS / Prism Central / AHV version (inventory)
properties.description: Uses the collector version inventory (Category == "inventory") to flag clusters, Prism Central instances and AHV hosts running a release below the fix for NXSA-0058 (CVE-2026-84731) or the AHV kernel advisories (CVE-2026-31431, CVE-2026-53362, CVE-2026-46300 - all in CISA KEV), or a release train older than the advisories cover. Update the FixedVersions table as new advisories are published.
properties.query:
// Fixed releases per advisory. Keep this table current as Nutanix publishes new NXSAs.
let FixedVersions = datatable(Product:string, Train:string, FixedIn:string, Advisory:string, Cves:string)[
    "AOS",          "7.6",  "7.6.0.8",   "NXSA-0058", "CVE-2026-84731 (Prism auth bypass, public PoC)",
    "AOS",          "7.5",  "7.5.2",     "NXSA-0058", "CVE-2026-84731 (Prism auth bypass, public PoC)",
    "AOS",          "7.3",  "7.3.1.18",  "NXSA-0058", "CVE-2026-84731 (Prism auth bypass, public PoC)",
    "PrismCentral", "7.6",  "7.6.0.8",   "NXSA-0058", "CVE-2026-84731 (Prism auth bypass, public PoC)",
    "PrismCentral", "7.5",  "7.5.2",     "NXSA-0058", "CVE-2026-84731 (Prism auth bypass, public PoC)",
    "PrismCentral", "7.3",  "7.3.1.18",  "NXSA-0058", "CVE-2026-84731 (Prism auth bypass, public PoC)",
    "AHV",          "11.2", "11.2.0.2",  "NXSA-0047/0048/0055", "CVE-2026-31431, CVE-2026-53362, CVE-2026-46300 (kernel, CISA KEV)",
    "AHV",          "11.0", "11.0.1.8",  "NXSA-0047/0048/0055", "CVE-2026-31431, CVE-2026-53362, CVE-2026-46300 (kernel, CISA KEV)",
    "AHV",          "10.3", "10.3.1.14", "NXSA-0047/0048/0055", "CVE-2026-31431, CVE-2026-53362, CVE-2026-46300 (kernel, CISA KEV)"
];
let Trains = FixedVersions
| summarize MinTrain = min(parse_version(Train)), MaxTrain = max(parse_version(Train)) by Product;
Nutanix_CL
| where Category == "inventory" and OperationType == "VERSION"
| where SourceEntityType in ("AOS", "PrismCentral", "AHV")
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SourceEntityUuid, SourceEntityType
| extend Product = SourceEntityType, Version = trim(@"\s+", Title)
| extend Train = extract(@"^(\d+\.\d+)", 1, Version)
| join kind=leftouter (FixedVersions) on Product, Train
| join kind=leftouter (Trains) on Product
| extend TrainVer = parse_version(Train)
| extend Status = case(
    Version startswith "pc." or isempty(Train) or TrainVer < MinTrain, "Unsupported / pre-fix release train - upgrade",
    isnotempty(FixedIn) and parse_version(Version) < parse_version(FixedIn), strcat("Below fixed release ", FixedIn),
    isempty(FixedIn) and TrainVer < MaxTrain, "Release train not in advisory table - verify manually",
    "OK")
| where Status != "OK"
| extend EntityName = extract(@" on (.+)$", 1, Message)
| project TimeGenerated, NutanixClusterName, Product, EntityName, Version, Status, Advisory, Cves, SourceEntityUuid
| extend HostCustomEntity = iff(isnotempty(EntityName), EntityName, NutanixClusterName)

properties.displayName: Nutanix - VM powered off then disk cloned / attached / detached by the same actor
properties.description: The same actor powers off a VM and, within 2 hours, clones, attaches, detaches or exports a disk. This is the offline-disk technique used to steal NTDS.dit from virtual domain controllers (Scattered Spider, Akira) without touching the guest OS.
properties.query:
let Window = 2h;
let PowerOffs = Nutanix_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(3h)
| where Category == "audit"
| where tolower(SourceEntityType) has "vm"
| where OperationType has "POWER_OFF" or Message has_any ("power off", "powered off", "power_off", "poweroff", "shutdown", "shut down")
| where isnotempty(ActorUser)
| project PowerOffTime = TimeGenerated, Actor = tolower(ActorUser), NutanixClusterName, PowerOffVm = SourceEntityUuid, PowerOffMessage = Message;
Nutanix_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where Category == "audit"
| where OperationType has_any ("CLONE", "ATTACH", "DETACH") or Message has_any ("clone", "cloned", "attach", "attached", "detach", "detached", "export", "download")
| where tolower(SourceEntityType) has_any ("vm", "disk", "volume", "image") or Message has_any ("disk", "vdisk", "volume group", "volume_group")
| where isnotempty(ActorUser)
| project DiskOpTime = TimeGenerated, Actor = tolower(ActorUser), ActorUser, NutanixClusterName, DiskOpMessage = Message, DiskOpEntity = SourceEntityUuid, SourceIp
| join kind=inner PowerOffs on Actor, NutanixClusterName
| where DiskOpTime between (PowerOffTime .. (PowerOffTime + Window))
| summarize PowerOffTime = min(PowerOffTime), DiskOpTime = max(DiskOpTime), PoweredOffVms = make_set(PowerOffVm, 10), PowerOffMessages = make_set(PowerOffMessage, 5), DiskOps = make_set(DiskOpMessage, 10), SourceIps = make_set(SourceIp, 10) by ActorUser, NutanixClusterName
| extend AccountCustomEntity = ActorUser, HostCustomEntity = NutanixClusterName, IpCustomEntity = tostring(SourceIps[0])

properties.displayName: Nutanix - Mass VM power-off or VM failures on a cluster
properties.description: Ten or more distinct VMs on one cluster were powered off, crashed, failed to boot or hit I/O errors within 15 minutes. Hypervisor-level ransomware (Akira encrypting AHV .qcow2 disks, CISA AA24-109A) and destructive attacks stop VMs en masse before encrypting. Tune VmThreshold for your estate.
properties.query:
let VmThreshold = 10;
Nutanix_CL
| where (Category == "audit" and tolower(SourceEntityType) has "vm"
        and (OperationType has "POWER_OFF" or Message has_any ("power off", "powered off", "power_off", "poweroff", "shutdown", "shut down", "hard reset")))
    or (Category in ("alert", "event")
        and Message has_any ("crash", "crashed", "failed to boot", "boot failure", "i/o error", "io error", "ha restart", "restarted by ha", "vm failure", "unexpectedly powered off", "unresponsive"))
| extend VmKey = iff(isnotempty(SourceEntityUuid), SourceEntityUuid, strcat(Title, "|", tostring(AffectedEntities)))
| summarize Vms = dcount(VmKey), Events = count(), Actors = make_set(ActorUser, 10), Samples = make_set(Message, 10), SourceIps = make_set(SourceIp, 10), StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated) by NutanixClusterName, Bucket = bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where Vms >= VmThreshold
| extend AccountCustomEntity = tostring(Actors[0]), HostCustomEntity = NutanixClusterName, IpCustomEntity = tostring(SourceIps[0])

properties.displayName: Nutanix - HTML or script injected into a login username (CVE-2024-12223)
properties.description: An audit, event or alert record contains HTML/JavaScript in the username or message, consistent with the stored XSS in the Prism login page (CVE-2024-12223), where a crafted username executes in an administrator's browser when they view the audit log.
properties.query:
let XssPattern = @"(?i)<\s*/?\s*(script|img|svg|iframe|body)\b|javascript:|on(error|load|mouseover)\s*=";
Nutanix_CL
| where Category in ("audit", "event", "alert")
| where ActorUser matches regex XssPattern or Message matches regex XssPattern
| extend AccountCustomEntity = ActorUser, HostCustomEntity = NutanixClusterName, IpCustomEntity = SourceIp

properties.displayName: Nutanix - Firmware, LCM upgrade, BMC/BIOS or certificate change
properties.description: Lifecycle Manager (LCM) upgrades, firmware/BMC/BIOS updates and SSL/CA certificate changes alter the trust base of the platform. Legitimate during maintenance; suspicious outside it. OutsideChangeWindow is computed from the configurable window; set OnlyOutsideChangeWindow = true to alert only on out-of-window changes.

properties.displayName: Nutanix - Akira / ransomware indicators
properties.description: Matches indicators from CISA AA24-109A (Akira, which has encrypted Nutanix AHV VM disks): the attacker-created account "itadm", Akira file extensions (.akira, .akiranew, .aki, .powerranges), and ransomware alerts such as Nutanix Files ransomware protection.
properties.query:
let RansomExtensions = @"(?i)\.(akira|akiranew|aki|powerranges)\b";
Nutanix_CL
| where tolower(ActorUser) == "itadm"
    or Message matches regex RansomExtensions or Title matches regex RansomExtensions
    or Message has "ransomware" or Title has "ransomware"
| extend Indicator = case(
    tolower(ActorUser) == "itadm", "Akira-associated account name 'itadm'",
    Message has "ransomware" or Title has "ransomware", "Ransomware keyword (e.g. Nutanix Files ransomware protection)",
    "Akira ransomware file extension")
| extend AccountCustomEntity = ActorUser, HostCustomEntity = NutanixClusterName, IpCustomEntity = SourceIp
